notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
[u][b]Updates and Fixes:[/b][/u]
- auto aim while attacking as well as aiming.
-[FIX] player was skating while aiming is now fixed.
-A small guide to map machanics at start of game.
-save location system when dying , you spawn near recent location.
-[FIX] NPCs used to stuck when in eachother's path is now fixed.
-Added some world bound colliders to prevent player moving out of map.
